simple.summary: עִיר הַמֶּלַח (ʻÎyr ham-Melach) means Irham-Melach , a place near Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 15 62.

definitions.full: H5898. Ir Hammelach עִירהַֿמֶּ֫לַח proper name, of a location ( city of salt ) in desert of Judah, Josh 15:62 (P; + Ên-gedi), πόλεις Σαδων (A ᵐ5 L [τῶν] ἁλῶν ); site unknown.
definitions.rootNote: from 5892 and 4417 with the article of substance interp.; city of (the) salt;
